findings: The vulnerable source-to-sink overwrite, atomic BIC, immediate-parent absence, and direct reversal all reproduce from the clone.

The first-party advisory is published and CVE-2026-76634 is PUBLISHED, but its prose overstates the id_pessoa sink as selecting full profile PII and inconsistently says v3.2.14 and earlier. The inspected code supports arbitrary adm_configurado lookup and later page-side cargo/self-other decision distortion; the primary record already preserves this distinction and correctly locates first affected tag 3.6.0.
